NOW, THEREFORE,
• I, CORAZON C. AQUINO, President
of the Philippines, do hereby order:
Sectoral Representatives. - There
shall be twenty-five (25) sectoral representatives to
the louse of Representatives.
Nine (9) sectors shall be represented in the House
of Representatives, namely:
(al labor; (b) peasant:
(el urban poor; (al indigenous cultural communities;
women; (f) youth; (a) veterans; (h) the elderly
and (il the disabled, whose representatives shall be
appointed by the President from the nominees of their
respective sectors or of a member of the sector in the
manner herein provided.
Scope of the Sectors. - The labor
sector refers to the industrial labor group, which
includes all non-agricultural workers and emplovees.

2 -
The peasant sector covers the agricultural group,
which includes all persons who personally and physically
till the land as their principal occupation, agricultural
tenants and lessees, r.ral workers and farm employees,
owner-cultivators, settlers and small fishermen.
The Urban poor seesor includes the underprivileged
and homeless citizens in urban areas.
The indigenous cultural communities sector covers
all ethnic groups and cultural communities.
The women sector stall cover all women.
The vouth sector e-braces persons not more than thirty-
five years of age.
The veterans sector embraces persons recognized as such
veterans by the Armed Forces of the Philippines.
The elderly sector covers persons who are sixty-five
years of age or over.
The sector of the disabled covers the physically and
socially disabled.
Nominations.
Nominations of the
sectoral representatives to the House of Representatives
must be made by the organization/s or aggroupment of members
of the sectoral groups defined in Section 2 hereof or by a
member of the sector.
All nominations shall be filed with the office of
the President not later than July 20, 1987.
Nominations must be in writing and accompanied
by the following supporting documents, namely: (1) curri-
culum vitae of the nominee/s; (ii) an indication of the
sector to be represented by the nominee; (iii) an endorse-
ment of the nominating group or individual; and (iv) such
other relevant materials as may help the appointing authority.
Term. - The sectoral representatives ap-
pointed to the House of Representatives shall serve until
noon of June 30, 1992.
Vacancy. - In case of vacancy in the seats
reserved for sectoral representatives in the House of
Representatives, the President shall fill the vacancy

_ 3
by appointing a representative for such sector who
shall serve for the unexpired term.
Separability Clause. - Any portion
or provision of this Executive Order that may be
deemed unconstitutional shall not have the effect of
nullifying other portions or provisions thereof as
long as such remaining portions or provisions can still
subsist and be given effect in their entirety.
Effectivity Clause. - This Executive
Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 18th day of
June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-seven.
